The SL-LET specification ensures that the data is published for Swc03 irrespectively of the chosen time slot at the end of the corresponding SL-LET intervals, here SL-LET2 and SL-LET3. On the other hand, the SL-LET interval SL-LET21 also remains valid in case of non-distributed communication (intra-ECU and based on the same clock), as the output of Swc01 has to be buffered before Swc02 may read it. This can be seen in Figure 8.8, where the offset of the LET interval LET2 is a result of the decomposition from SL-LET to LET intervals.
